posts.title: BUILD-UP drill
posts.body: We split the field in 3 zones. Each zone has a defender. The goal of the team with possesion to go through each zone using numerical advantage and score in the end. Defenders cannot leave their zones. Played 4vs3 + goalkeepers on both sides.

posts.title: POSSESION + FINISHING + PRESSING
posts.body:
6 players in possesion have to do 10 passes at least and then can attack the goal. And they will have pressure  of not lose the ball after 10 passes and try to score, otherwise they will have to start over.

If 3 pressing players steal the ball they can score right away (they can't really hold the ball for too long because of numerical disadvantage so they have to play quickly and agressive). 3 players can really do coordinated pressing

It's 6 field players in possesion vs 3 pressing them which is what often happens in the game!
